title: Required Checks and Codeowners
objective: Add a CODEOWNERS file in .github, commit it, and print the commit subject and the file.
hint: Commit the README on main, then New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force for the .github folder. Set-Content the CODEOWNERS file with * @example-owner, git add, git commit -q -m Add codeowners file. Then Write-Output (git log -1 --format=%s) and Get-Content on the CODEOWNERS file.
